result.instructions: Tools for Tshirtgang, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which blank styles and colours can I print, and what do they cost?"; "Create a product from this design URL in black, classic tee."; "Show me my orders that are still unpaid or processing.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Tshirtgang data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run tshirtgang_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run tshirtgang_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run tshirtgang_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. tshirtgang_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: tshirtgang_get_available_products
tools.title: Get available blank products
tools.description: List the blank catalogue: style, colour, size, price and stock for each printable combination. Narrow by style, colour or size; unfiltered calls can return thousands of rows. Tshirtgang API: GetAvailableProducts.

style.description: Style name, e.g. "Classic", or numeric style ID.

color.description: Colour name, e.g. "Black". Exact match only.

size.description: Size code, e.g. S, M, L, XL, 2XL.

available.description: true = only in-stock rows, false = only unavailable rows.

tools.name: tshirtgang_list_products
tools.title: List my products
tools.description: List the products in this seller's catalogue, with product_id, title, style, colour, category and preview image. Use product_id in tshirtgang_create_order. Tshirtgang API: GetSellerProducts.

style.description: Style name, e.g. "Classic", or numeric style ID.

color.description: Colour name, e.g. "Black". Exact match only.

product_id.description: Look up one product by its product_id.

tools.name: tshirtgang_get_product_latency
tools.title: Get production time
tools.description: Estimate production time in business days (before shipping) for each style, or for one style. Use it to show 'ships in X days'. Tshirtgang API: GetProductLatency.

style.description: Style name, e.g. "Classic", or numeric style ID.

tools.name: tshirtgang_get_order_history
tools.title: Get order history
tools.description: Read this seller's orders with status, recipient, item, price and tracking. Filter by order_number for one order, or by order_status. Pages hold up to 100 orders. Address fields are returned only to the key that placed the order. Tshirtgang API: GetSellerHistory.

order_number.description: One order number. Ignores page and items_per_page.

tools.name: tshirtgang_create_product
tools.title: Create a product
tools.description: Create a catalogue product from a public HTTPS PNG design. The product is made for every size priced for that style and colour. The image is fetched at call time; a bad URL rejects the call and creates nothing. Each call creates a new product. Tshirtgang API: CreateProduct.

title.description: Product title shown on the product page and invoices.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the design PNG (transparent background, at least 2400x3200 for DTG).

style.description: Style name, e.g. "Classic", "Hoodie". Use tshirtgang_get_available_products to list them.

color.description: One colour name, e.g. "Black". Use tshirtgang_get_available_products to list them.

custom_category.description: Custom category name. Created if it does not exist.

positions.description: Extra print positions. Each non-back position adds $3.50 per unit. Not every style offers every position.

back.description: Back print PNG. Adds $5.00 per unit.

left_chest.description: HTTPS URL of a PNG for this print position.

right_chest.description: HTTPS URL of a PNG for this print position.

left_sleeve.description: HTTPS URL of a PNG for this print position.

right_sleeve.description: HTTPS URL of a PNG for this print position.

yoke.description: HTTPS URL of a PNG for this print position.

inner_neck.description: HTTPS URL of a PNG for this print position.

outer_neck.description: HTTPS URL of a PNG for this print position.

name_plate.description: HTTPS URL of a PNG for this print position.

lower_back.description: HTTPS URL of a PNG for this print position.

tools.name: tshirtgang_create_order
tools.title: Create an order
tools.description: Submit a print-on-demand order that is paid from the seller account and shipped to a real recipient. Use product_id from tshirtgang_list_products. Confirm the recipient, items and quantities with the user first. Repeating a market_id1 returns the original order instead of a new one. Tshirtgang API: CreateOrder.

address1.description: Street address, including the house number.

state.description: State or province. Two-letter code for US and CA.

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US, CA, GB.

phone.description: Recipient phone. Some carriers require it.

size.description: Size code, e.g. S, M, L, XL, 2XL.

backprint.description: true when the product has back-print artwork.

priority_shipping.description: true for the 1-2 business day lane. Costs more.

market_id1.description: Your own order ID. Makes the call idempotent.

order.description: One or more items to print and ship.
